cohort: 84 healthy term newborns delivered by cesarean section
finding: Not performing ONPS in newborns delivered by cesarean section does not affect SpO2 and HR in the first postpartum hour.
mod_finding: This study found that not performing oro-and naso-pharyngeal suction (ONPS) in newborns delivered by cesarean section did not affect their SpO2 and heart rate in the first postpartum hour.
